integrity: All formulas in the accepted statement have analytic proofs. The finite exact-rational verifier is supplemental. Publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The sharp 1/3 discrepancy is only the supremum over the specified three-cell four-parameter family. Comparisons do not assert general three-cell or high-dimensional bounds, solver instability, or failure of repeated projected Euler. Earlier general sweeping-process literature may contain an equivalent result.
title: Sharp three-cell lag between projected descent and a single capped-simplex projection
